nodes.name: Magnetron Sputtering on Cu
nodes.procedure: Magnetron sputtering was used to construct the HEA interphase layer on a Cu substrate. The parameters were optimized using particle swarm optimization (PSO). The optimal experimental conditions were sputtering power P = 40 W, sputtering time t = 530 s, and substrate rotation speed r = 6.

unit_operations.name: Magnetron Sputtering
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: The optimal experimental conditions are P = 40 W, t = 530 s, and r = 6. Magnetron sputtering, a physical vapor deposition technique, enables coating at room temperature and in an inert atmosphere
